summary: Standing Monroe County, Tennessee lookout also called Madisonville; NHLR-registered March 2014; no build date, design or staffing record found.

events.note: Registered March 14, 2014 as US 992, TN 13; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: Register coordinates, about 22 m from the OpenStreetMap node
administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry (Register spells it Tenneessee)
administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry
tower listed as Madisonville in Monroe County
OpenStreetMap coordinates close to the Register's

corrections.why: The Register spelling is a typo; Forest Lookouts spells the agency correctly.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register calls it Hiwassee Knobs Fire Tower; Tennessee Landforms and OpenStreetMap use Madisonville. The OpenStreetMap point is about 22 m from the Register's coordinates, so the names most likely refer to one tower. This is an inference from location only.
The Register gives 1,332 ft (406 m), OpenStreetMap 410 m and Tennessee Landforms 1,383 ft. The story reports all three and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The cached Register page is short (about 700 characters) and has no visit report, build date, design or staffing text. No build history found in two searches. Identity with the Madisonville names rests on coordinates only (about 22 m apart, computed from the Register's N 35.576389 W 084.378333 and the OSM node). Tennessee Landforms code for this row is MOT003. The access field in the brief is unknown and was left out of facts because no source gives it.
